text: New C++ node nodes/head_camera_cpp owns the head IMX708 through libcamera (replacing camera_ros): 2304:1296 sensor mode, 1152x648 at 30 fps, continuous autofocus, publishing /head_camera/image_raw, /head_camera/image_raw/compressed (configured JPEG quality honoured) and /head_camera/camera_info, frame_id head_camera_optical_frame.

Zoom: a JSON request on /head_camera/zoom/command (normalised point, factor 2/4/8, request id) runs windowed AF, switches to 4608x2592 StillCapture, takes one frame, publishes a native-resolution JPEG crop (<= 1024 px) on /head_camera/zoom/image and a JSON result on /head_camera/zoom/result, then restores the 30 fps mode; failures give an error result and always restore the stream; no placeholder images.

mcp_server: get_camera_image gains an optional zoom parameter returning the crop; default view stays ~384 px; mcp_server and claude_agent camera config, tool docs and prompts move to /head_camera and describe the head camera.
web_ui: Arm tab head_camera_topic, Head tab rgb_camera_topic on /head_camera/image_raw/compressed, click-to-zoom on the Head tab RGB view with a zoom factor, crop shown once then back to live.
pi_cameras retired entirely; Ansible deploys head_camera_cpp (node type, cgroup tier, config, build against the same pinned libcamera, metrics target), tests and READMEs updated.

All suites green (node gtests, root pytest, lint, ansible lint/syntax, mcp_server, claude_agent, web_ui tests); deployed and verified on the robot (30 fps measured, one zoom from the agent tool, one from the web UI).
Default stream 30 fps at an appropriate resolution: 2304:1296 sensor mode, 1152x648, continuous AF.
Zoom switches to full resolution only on request, autofocuses on the zoom point; re-taking a picture is allowed.
Zoom API: point (normalised u, v in the default view) + factor 2/4/8; crop <= 1024 px JPEG.
Optional zoom parameter on the existing mcp_server camera-image tool (not a new tool); default agent view stays ~384 px wide (16:9 now).
Web UI click-to-zoom, one frame at a time, then back to live.
Zoom crops are not saved to disk.
Head (formerly front) camera only: no zoom for the gripper camera or the ToF.
The JPEG quality bug (configured quality ignored) is fixed by the new node honouring its configured quality.

The Camera Module 3 and the Arducam ToF form the robot head on the pan/tilt stand: the node is nodes/head_camera_cpp publishing /head_camera/* with frame head_camera_optical_frame; every /front_camera consumer (mcp_server/claude_agent config and prompts, web_ui Arm head_camera_topic, Head tab rgb_camera_topic) moves to /head_camera; click-to-zoom lives on the Head tab RGB view; pi_cameras retired entirely (head_camera_cpp builds against the same libcamera, camera_ros purged); no TF changes (frame parented to the pan/tilt chain later, a non-goal).
